page_title: LAZ 0-1 ACM | Lazio v AC Milan 01/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Marco Di Bello has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Di Bello had an easy-decision to make.
90+6' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) reacts stupidly and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
90+5' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card. Rafael Leao (AC Milan) will miss the next game.
90+5' Adam Marusic (Lazio) attempts to protest after receiving a red card, but it's too late! It was an unjustified decision by the referee, but it doesn't change the fact that it's a red.
90+3' A pass from Matteo Guendouzi gives Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) a shooting opportunity on the edge of the box, but the effort is poor and goes well wide of the right post.
90+3' One of the players from AC Milan times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+2' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the left post.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
88' 0 - 1 Goal! Noah Okafor (AC Milan) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
88' Great save! Noah Okafor (AC Milan) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Ivan Provedel.
84' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
82' Close! Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
81' Here comes a substitution. Malick Thiaw (AC Milan) is brought on as a substitute for Matteo Gabbia.
81' Substitution. Simon Kjaer leaves the pitch and is replaced by Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan).
80' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) sends a cross into the box from the free kick, but his effort lacks accuracy and goes well out of play. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
80' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan).
78' The game has come to an end for Matias Vecino. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Danilo Cataldi (Lazio).
77' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Marco Di Bello lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
77' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The AC Milan players look gutted.
77' Wait! Referee Marco Di Bello has indicated he is going to review the AC Milan goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
77' Goal! Rafael Leao (AC Milan) coolly slotted the ball past the goalkeeper.
75' CHANCE! Ciro Immobile (Lazio) fires just wide of the right post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Gustav Isaksen.
75' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the roof of the net, but Ivan Provedel was alert and made an amazing save!
73' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ivan Provedel intercepts the ball.
73' A quickly taken corner by AC Milan.

73' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. AC Milan get a corner.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Noah Okafor (AC Milan) replaces Yacine Adli.
70' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Yacine Adli (AC Milan) was quite harsh and Marco Di Bello didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
69' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) tries to find Ciro Immobile, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
68' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 6:8. The current number of shots on goal is 3:2.
66' That will be all from Mattia Zaccagni who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Gustav Isaksen (Lazio).

66' What a poor attempt! Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes miles wide to the right.
65' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Ivan Provedel is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
64' AC Milan quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
64' Stefano Pioli decides to make a substitution. Ismael Bennacer will be replaced by Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan).
64' It's time for a substitution. Davide Calabria (AC Milan) comes on in place of Alessandro Florenzi.
64' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) serves up a nice cross, but Ivan Provedel punches the ball away. The ball is out of play and AC Milan manage to earn a corner.
62' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the left post, but Mike Maignan is prepared and dives to thwart him.
61' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card. Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
60' Maurizio Sarri prepares a substitution. Taty Castellanos is replaced by Ciro Immobile (Lazio).
60' Maurizio Sarri is forced to make a tactical change due to a red card. Luis Alberto (Lazio) will be replaced by Elseid Hysaj.
58' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) will miss the next game.
57' The match has ended for Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) as he picks up his second yellow card and referee Marco Di Bello pulls out a red card!
56' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
56' Corner kick. Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is ready to send the ball into the box.

55' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. AC Milan have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
53' Luis Alberto (Lazio) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Mike Maignan comes off the line to clear the ball away.
52' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) fails to send in a decent cross from the free kick from the edge of the box. His effort goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.

50' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) has tested the patience of referee Marco Di Bello and goes into the book for a previous late challenge. Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
50' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
48' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar.
46' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Ivan Provedel, who smothers the ball.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Marco Di Bello has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Theo Hernandez sends over a penetrating corner which finds the head of Olivier Giroud (AC Milan), but his effort from close range is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
45+2' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) will deliver the corner kick.

45+1' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went straight towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save. It will be a corner kick for AC Milan.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
43' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
41' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
39' Luis Alberto (Lazio) collects a pass and has an effort from distance to the bottom right corner, but Mike Maignan answers with a superb save to deny him.
36' The ball is cleared out of defence to the edge of the box where Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) hits a first-time shot back towards goal. Unfortunately for him, the ball flashes high over the bar.
36' The resulting corner from Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

35' Yacine Adli (AC Milan) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to AC Milan.
34' Simon Kjaer (AC Milan) sends a long ball forward to Christian Pulisic, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The linesman signals a throw-in for Lazio.
34' 4:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. Shots on target – 1:0.
33' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) sends a cross into the box, but Mike Maignan comes off his line to gather the ball.
30' Luis Alberto (Lazio) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
29' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Marco Di Bello signals. Lazio earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
29' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) but poses no threat.
27' Luis Alberto (Lazio) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mike Maignan intercepts the ball.
27' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) works the corner short.
26' Mario Gila (Lazio) is able to continue to play.
26' Mario Gila (Lazio) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
25' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle and signals a foul after Yacine Adli (AC Milan) brought his opponent down.
22' Referee Marco Di Bello halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Maurizio Sarri, then shows him a yellow.
22' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) elects to shoot from the edge of the box instead of sending the free kick into the box, but the defensive wall manages to block the shot. Wasted opportunity!
20' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle after Matias Vecino (Lazio) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. AC Milan are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
20' Luis Alberto (Lazio) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
19' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
18' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
15' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
14' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
12' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

11' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a low shot from long range towards the middle of the net, but Mike Maignan makes a comfortable save to stop the effort.
8' Matias Vecino (Lazio) meets a fine cross on the edge of the box from the resulting corner kick and shoots. His shot flies just wide of the left post.
8' Luis Alberto (Lazio) steps up to send the ball in.

7' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, Lazio are awarded a corner kick.
3' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
2' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. AC Milan will have the kick-off.
Marco Di Bello is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
Hello and welcome to our live text commentary! We will provide you with instant updates of everything that happens in the match. The starting lineups will be announced very soon.
